verbatim: Fig.4. Effect of biocontrol agent(s) application on disease incidence in tomato seedlings grown on pots containing soil infested or not with R. solani. n_source: Not resolvable from the original. p8 section 2.6 says shoots and roots were collected 'upon termination of each of the 3 experimental replicates'. Methods 4.5 on p13-14 (receipts SRC-4d266bbbe17eeb2d860067ac and SRC-b1705f0c268e864060c19873) has 15 plants per treatment, 5 removed for the colonization check, and 'the rest of the plants (10 each)' potted. Methods 4.8 on p14 says 'All assays described above were repeated three times. Means and standard deviations were calculated for each independent experiment.' It is not stated whether the plotted mean and SD use the 3 independent experiments or the plants of one experiment, and plant survival after stress is not reported. n is left null rather than guessed.
